content.text:
The quest "Down into Vicrium" is complete and my notes are handed in, so I'm done.

I took the Old Lower Adit into the Lower Galleries. The crocodiles didn't stop me, and I didn't touch Ah-Zish or the smuggler. The knights' strongbox held an old parchment map showing seven towers in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island.

I brought the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. She named me Toh-Wo, "Secret-Speaker", paid me 200 gold and let me choose a weapon, so I took the rapier over the quarterstaff. I now report to her officer, Never-Writes-Twice. She says the crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha. She also warned me off Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former order member who went mad on sap and killed her minders.

Still unanswered:
- What the Root and the Eye of Argonia are.
- How Nesh-Deeka's order knows what it knows ("we listen").
- Why the Unbound seal trees.
- What the seven towers are.

The leads I have left are Skeith Isle, the Unbound, and the Collector, Ennodius Vanin.
